**SUBLET - Available May 1st: Private room & private bathroom in spacious westside apartment with rooftop patio! 2-month sublease, then flexible month-to-month after that**

Looking for a short or long-term roommate to share my top-floor, two-bedroom apartment in Del Rey! No pets allowed, unfortunately. The apartment is conveniently located between Culver City, Mar Vista, and Marina del Rey. This spot includes your own parking space in a gated garage with 24/7 camera surveillance. 

Common areas are fully furnished! The space is bright & airy, with vaulted ceilings, cozy furnishings, and a ton of natural light. The living area has two couches, a 65” TV with a bunch of streaming services, a gas fireplace, and lots of plants (we have very clean air in here!). The kitchen has a dishwasher, espresso machine, air fryer, toaster oven, and plenty of cabinet and fridge space. There’s a staircase leading to the private rooftop patio with an awesome green space filled with over 100 plants, cozy patio furniture, and gorgeous views of the Santa Monica Mountains, Marina del Rey, Westwood, and beyond.

**About the Bedroom & Bathroom**
- Unfurnished.
- Ample closet space (a full wall of 3 sliding doors). 
- Large window with beautiful natural light throughout the day.
- Clean laminate floors.
- Private attached bathroom with plenty of storage and a good-sized shower.

**Building Amenities**

- Laundry rooms on each floor ($2 per wash/dry).
- Elevator access.
- Gated parking garage.
- Located along the Culver Bike Path; bike to the beach in less than 20 minutes! 

**About Me**

I’m a 34-year-old environmental consultant working remotely. I’m usually home working during the weekdays (office space is in my bedroom), but often work elsewhere and still maintain an active lifestyle running, gardening, and traveling when I can. I don’t party or have company over often and strive to keep the place clean & organized, so it’s generally a peaceful, relaxing space. Ideally, I’m looking for someone who’s LGBTQ+ friendly, fully employed, and shares a similar appreciation for cleanliness and mutual respect for the shared areas. I love animals, but no pets allowed unfortunately! 

**Rent**
The rate is $1,795 monthly, all-inclusive (covers rent, utilities, parking). The sublease agreement will be for 2 months beginning May 1st and then month-to-month beginning July 1st (if you decide to stay longer). There is a $1,000 refundable security deposit, Total = $2,740 when you move in. Proof of income + a background check will be required. Move-in date: May 1st, 2026, but my current roommate may be leaving before then so there’s a chance the move-in date could be a few days before then. 

If this sounds like a good fit, send me a little bit about yourself and what you’re looking for, and we can set up a FaceTime or in-person tour so you can see the place and we can chat!
